raw_text: Seeing a flood of posts today claiming COVID started in India based on sewage data. This is a coordinated disinfo campaign from Chinese state media. The preprint they cite was rejected and the authors have ties to Wuhan Institute of Virology. Classic blame-shifting tactic. Thread on how to spot these campaigns in the wild.
clean_text: Bluesky health disinformation tracker flagged coordinated posts claiming COVID originated in India based on rejected preprint studies with ties to Wuhan Institute of Virology.
